C1635.title: University of Chicago Research Uncovers Critical Meta Quest Headset Vulnerability
C1635.summary: Researchers at the University of Chicago identified a significant security flaw in Meta Quest headsets, allowing an attacker on the same Wi-Fi network to leverage developer mode to inject malware, clone the user's main screen, steal information, and tamper with user interactions—such as modifying transfer amounts without the user's knowledge.
